question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '6'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91b3f57628578a98dab20c7f807161af6c9fa92865b0b1ca7e2dc60dc7d4e79f.png]
solution:
When we compare the figures 1 and 2 we get:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdda46057ff0dfd1d9a49482f62f9629fe75b306c122b80885922bb05e8764f2.png] 

We observe that, when we move the dice towards left such that 3 and 2 are visible we find that on the left we have 6 and on the right we have 5 which means they both are opposite to each other. So **5** is the number on the face opposite the face showing 6.

Hence the correct answer is option 4)
